done_when:
All of the following are true:
- The customer is verified, and the verification was logged once in the conversation.
- Every requested dispute that passes the pre-filing rules and fits its account's open-dispute limit has been filed with file_debit_card_transaction_dispute_6281, one per transaction_id. - Any dispute held back by a rule, by the limit, by a failed match, or because the customer accepted the records has been explained. Held-back and dropped disputes set no card action.
- Each card's most severe action among its filed disputes has been performed once, after the last dispute: a freeze, a closure (reason lost, stolen or fraud_suspected), or nothing for keep_active.
- After a closure, a replacement was ordered if the customer wanted one and the tier allows it now, or the Entry-tier 48-hour wait was explained.
- If a closed card was lost or stolen, the cross-product check has been handed off.
- The customer has a per-dispute summary of liability, provisional credit, timelines, any affidavit and card status.
- If a call failed, the failure has been explained and a transfer offered. A transfer on request happened only on the 4th request.
